analysis.intent_details: Notify user that meeting transcription is ready and provide access link

action_items.action: Open the transcript to generate an AI summary or action items

responses.subject: Re: Tactiq: Meeting Transcription
responses.body:
Dear Tactiq Team,

Thank you for notifying me that my meeting transcript is ready. I will review the transcript and generate the AI summary and action items as needed.

Best regards,
Humbal
responses.rationale: A simple, professional acknowledgment confirms receipt of the notification while indicating next steps. This maintains appropriate business communication standards.

responses.subject: Re: Tactiq: Meeting Transcription
responses.body:
To Whom It May Concern,

I acknowledge receipt of your notification regarding the availability of my meeting transcript. I will access the transcript through the provided link to review the content and utilize the AI summary and action items features.

Sincerely,

responses.rationale: A more formal response is appropriate for professional business communications, especially when dealing with automated services. This maintains a professional tone while confirming the notification was received.
